discrepancies: Product-specific Debrox four-day limit supersedes book generic 3-5 day range.
Cipro HC is nonsterile and unsuitable with known/suspected perforation; fluoroquinolone class membership alone does not establish suitability.
Cortisporin TC label perforation caution does not override guideline preference for a non-ototoxic preparation.
Book blanket activity limits replaced by contextual water/device and pressure-equalization travel advice.
Ofloxacin age/indication wording conflicts documented and exact diagnosis-specific prescribing instructions preserved.
Generated repetitive bank contained ambiguous alternative valid actions; replaced with 46 focused original cases retaining all 28 original concepts.
